image_concepts.A: 파리채를 든 채 엉뚱한 허공을 노려보는 사람 + 바로 옆 벽에 앉은 큰 모기
image_concepts.B: 느긋하게 쉬는 의인화 모기 + 눈을 부릅뜬 채 지친 사람

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A. 어두운 침실, 파자마 차림 남성이 파리채를 쳐들고 눈을 부릅뜬 채 허공을 노려본다. 바로 옆 침대 머리맡 낮은 벽에 모기가 크게 앉아 있는데 그는 못 본다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail scene in a dim bedroom at night with one warm lamp on. An anonymous Korean man in his 30s with a warm likeable face, wearing pajamas, raises a fly swatter and glares wide-eyed at empty air in an exaggerated frantic expression, his upper body large in the center of the frame, crisp cutout look with strong rim light. Right beside his head, on the low wall above the headboard, a single mosquito rests motionless, rendered oversized and sharply detailed so viewers spot it instantly while he does not. Realistic textures, high contrast, playful humorous mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형. 불 켠 방에서 두 손으로 허공을 박수 치듯 잡았다가 빈손을 확인하며 황당해하는 여성, 어깨 너머 벽에 앉은 모기.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail scene in a brightly lit Korean apartment bedroom. An anonymous young Korean woman with a warm likeable face has just clapped her hands together in mid-air and is opening them to find nothing, her face showing exaggerated disbelief, upper body large on the left side of the frame with a crisp cutout look and rim light. Over her shoulder, on the plain white wall, a single mosquito sits still, oversized and in sharp focus. Bright realistic colors, humorous mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B. 벽에 앉은 큰 모기가 작은 선글라스를 쓰고 느긋하게 쉬는 모습, 그 앞에서 눈 밑이 퀭한 남성이 손전등을 들고 엉뚱한 천장을 비춘다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail with playful humor: a giant mosquito, oversized to fill the right third of the frame, rests on a bedroom wall wearing tiny sunglasses and looking relaxed. On the left, an exhausted anonymous Korean man in his 40s with dark circles under his eyes and messy hair points a flashlight at the empty ceiling in the wrong direction, exaggerated tired frustration on his face, crisp cutout look with strong rim light. Night bedroom background, realistic textures, bright subject lighting.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형. 새벽 3시 시계가 보이는 침실, 모기 물린 자국이 난 팔을 긁으며 이마를 짚은 남성, 그 위로 크게 확대된 모기 한 마리.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail in a dark bedroom with a digital clock glowing on the nightstand. An anonymous Korean man in his 30s with a warm likeable face sits up in bed, one hand pressed to his forehead in exaggerated despair, the other scratching a red mosquito bite on his arm, his upper body large in the center with a crisp cutout look and rim light. Above his head a single mosquito floats, oversized and sharply detailed. Moody night tones with a bright subject, humorous mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드. 사람 눈 하나가 화면 왼쪽을 크게 채우고, 오른쪽 하얀 벽 앞에서 모기가 흐릿하게 빠져나가는 순간.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail: an extreme close-up of a wide-open human eye fills the left half of the frame, the iris straining to the right. On the right, against a plain white wall, a single mosquito darts away with slight motion blur, just slipping out of a sharp circular zone of focus into blurry surroundings. Bright clean lighting, vivid realistic colors, intriguing mood.
